notes..scratch/service-clock/panel.json: The service-clock spike (docs/service-time-debut-clock.md). One row per major-league debut 2005-2025 with the season service line, the wire-resolved roster-add date and the roster-need counts. The 47MB transaction wire it was built from is git-ignored and not cataloged; rebuild it with .scratch/service-clock/pull.mjs.
notes..scratch/top-prospects-history/rows.json: Historical Top Prospects lists from TWO publications (pull.mjs for 2009-2024, pull-ba.mjs for 2005-2008, #946). One row per (season, rank, mlbId); mlbId joins to prospect-traits/bio.json with no crosswalk. Every row has a source field, mlb-pipeline or baseball-america: never pool the two without checking it. seasons.json is the per-season coverage record (status, depth, row count); depth is NOT always 100 (2009-2011 are top-50; 2020 and 2021 top out at 99). Both files are a plain top-level ARRAY, not a {meta,rows} wrapper: a wrapper threw on every row-grain query.
notes..scratch/prospect-value/panel.json: What a ranking is worth in dollars (docs/prospect-ranking-value.md). One row per player in the UNION of the ranked population and the 3,061-man debut cohort, with rank facts, career earnings joined from salaries.csv, and windowStatus: whether the ranking window sat inside a published list. A 2006 debut is censored, NOT unranked. Any query that compares ranked against unranked must filter windowStatus = observed-deep, or it measures a data gap. Same plain-ARRAY shape as top-prospects-history/rows.json; metadata sits in panel-meta.json.
notes.public/data/contracts-history/identity/e: Historical contract identity crosswalk (scripts/gen-contracts-identity.mjs): one row per source-CSV row, keyed on real MLB id. A row with no confident id has mlbId = null and confidence other than exact or fuzzy (docs/adr/0066-a-contract-row-with-no-confident-id-stays-unresolved.md). The four identity files share this note.
notes.public/data/contracts-history/terms/*.js: The dollar terms behind each identity row (scripts/gen-contracts-shards.mjs), one row per rowKey. Money fields mix numbers and free text, so this panel is read in full (see FULL_SCAN in the script).
notes.public/data/contracts-history/player/*.j: The same rows grouped by personId, 100 shards. DEFERRED: every shard mixes numbers and free text in term (100 shards), club_offer (78), settled_salary (65), player_request (8). A full scan of the __players view throws a cast error. See Known limits in docs/agents/research-database.md before you change this.
The file name carries a date stamp, so a glob keeps the view valid as new files land.
